scope: Dial branch implements family facts, guidance, checks and replay profile only

requests.request: Recognize hash-bound family evidence without rewriting frozen historical source files or bypassing preview gates.
requests.acceptance: Nine R11 entries resolve to selected closed evidence; assisted evidence stays distinct. A family review alone cannot start a formal run.

requests.request: Load and freeze the dial family guide and its checked public projection; select the R11 catalog explicitly. Keep generic role and tool semantics shared.
requests.acceptance: The actual prepared public inputs equal the reviewed geometry, BEST5 rules and guidance. No Oracle solution, live object truth or engineering history is inherited.

requests.request: Unify the independent dial, mosaic and relay edit APIs with adapters for existing files; keep classification profiles family-owned.
requests.acceptance: Existing source recordings and edits remain readable without rerunning physics; process/outcome events survive display edits; dial defaults to 10x/30fps.

requests.request: Read one source cursor per station, update every station pose and appearance, then render once using a separate global presentation clock.
requests.acceptance: Two stations with different removed intervals map the same global frame to different original times. On appearance_reset, restore that station's recorded initial_rgba before applying cumulative appearance_changes. End/loop policy is explicit. No common post-render video cut or physical integration.

requests.request: Reconcile already-committed changes with other worktrees by execution ownership, terminal outcome and evidence semantics, rather than replacing whole files.
requests.acceptance: Unknown executions remain fenced and assisted/failed/violated evidence is retained. Further control/evaluator changes receive impact review before a new experiment.

decisions_before_formal_gpt: Confirm model, topology and run/cost budgets for the new policy protocol; the old 1200s probe is not inherited silently.
Launch the initial policy with fresh permitted context; this engineering conversation contains answers.
Choose once-only completion hold versus explicitly labelled looping for the joint factory presentation.
